Definition: to break in pieces; figuratively, harass
BiblicalUsage: Ra'ats means to break in pieces, to shatter. Moses sang it of God's right hand: 'Thy right hand, O LORD, is become glorious in power: thy right hand, O LORD, hath dashed in pieces the enemy.' Judges says the Ammonites vexed and oppressed — literally broke — Israel for eighteen years.
TheologicalSignificance: I am convinced that the same breaking falls both ways: God breaks His enemies in pieces, and when Israel turns away, He lets her enemies break her.
